text:
sara (support): heads-up: WidgetCo reporting a lot of spans showing as orphaned in the Trace panel. They can see the top-level request and some 5xx traces, but child spans are missing links to the trace. customer pasted a couple failing request_ids and a dashboard link. /cc @dan @lee

dan (eng): on it. can you paste 2-3 request_ids + approx time window?

sara (support): request_ids: `8f3a1c9b`, `b2e7f004`, `c4a9d12e`
time window: 2025-07-14T10:05:00Z -> 2025-07-14T10:20:00Z
dashboard: https://console.redwood.internal/app/traces?panel=span-links (customer link)

lee (sre): quick look at ingestion logs — noticed a kafka consumer rebalance around 2025-07-14T10:12:20Z. consumer lag spiked on topic `spans-ingest`. Alerts fired (ingest-bot). suspect some span messages were processed late -> indexing arrived after trace entity was indexed -> parent refs missed. :thinking:

ingest-bot: ALERT: kafka_consumer_lag > 5000 for topic `spans-ingest` (partitions 4-7) at 2025-07-14T10:12:23Z.

dan (eng): yep, if spans arrive after the trace/parent got indexed, the linking job can miss them. we have a reconcilor/backfill but it needs to be run for that time range. can we run a targeted backfill for those request_ids/time window?

mira (eng-runtime): I can run the backfill, but need a sample span payload so I can verify field mappings (we've had name drift on `client_request_id` vs `request_id`). can you paste a raw span from the customer?

sara (support): pasted sample (redacted):
```
{
  "trace_id": "a1f8b3d4",
  "span_id": "7c2e9a00",
  "parent_id": "",
  "request_id": "8f3a1c9b",
  "service": "widget-api",
  "timestamp": "2025-07-14T10:11:58Z"
}
```

lee (sre): that `parent_id` empty looks like the child arrived before parent link was indexed (or parent id not normalized). indexing backlog confirms ~4k spans delayed for that minute.

mira (eng-runtime): plan: run reconcilor in dry-run for 2025-07-14T10:00:00Z -> 2025-07-14T10:30:00Z; check how many request_ids would be relinked. command:
```
./tools/reconcile_spans --from "2025-07-14T10:00:00Z" --to "2025-07-14T10:30:00Z" --dry-run --filter-request-ids 8f3a1c9b,b2e7f004,c4a9d12e
```

dan (eng): i'll run the dry-run now. if output looks sane we'll run with `--apply` and monitor dashboards. creating internal incident and assigning eng-runtime.

ops-bot: Created incident INC-4521: "Span-linking regressions after kafka rebalance". Pager notified.

lee (sre): follow-up: need to tune alert thresholds and add an auto-retry to the reprocessor when consumer lag > threshold. this will reduce manual backfills.

mira (eng-runtime): agreed. after we confirm backfill works i'll create a follow-up PR to add an auto-retry job and a dashboard widget for missed-parent-count.

dan (eng): dry-run done -> results: 213 spans eligible to be relinked (includes the 3 request_ids). output looks correct. prepping `--apply` in 10m.

sara (support): told customer we have a remediation plan and will update in ~30m.

lee (sre): root cause summary for incident: kafka consumer rebalance + temporary lag caused delayed span ingestion; some spans indexed after their parent trace, causing missing parent refs in Trace panel. remediation: targeted reconcilor run + tune consumer/alerts + add auto-retry.

mira (eng-runtime): applied backfill at 2025-07-14T10:40Z, relinked 213 spans. verified in console — two of the customer's request_ids now show full span trees. monitoring: backfill job succeeded, no errors.

dan (eng): closing incident INC-4521, moving follow-ups to TICKET-7802 (auto-retry + alerts).

sara (support): thanks team. i'll ping the customer with the confirmation + postmortem. :raised_hands:

mira (eng-runtime): pls add the sample payload to the incident so we can validate field mapping in case of future schema drift.

sara (support): added sample to INC-4521.

dan (eng): nice work.

sara (support): thx :heart:
